key_insight: The paper gives a machine-checked Lean 4 foundation for quantum neural network design, unifying expressivity and trainability results under certified assumptions.
engineering_relevance: It enables more reliable QNN architecture selection by turning key theoretical guarantees into proof-kernel-checked statements that can guide automated or AI-assisted quantum ML design.
method: Formalized QNN theory in Lean 4 with every analytic assumption either proved or named.
Proved exact single-qubit QNN characterizations, a quantum phase processing theorem, and an overparameterization bound via DLA dimension.
Derived trainability results including a direct-sum loss-variance law and a capstone conditional-variance/loss-reconstruction theorem in DLA coordinates.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a connected Lean 4 development with a proof kernel and notes eight corrections and clarifications uncovered relative to the informal arguments.
watch_item: Several results remain conditional on explicit hypotheses, so practical use depends on whether a target QNN family satisfies the required controllability, two-design, or DLA assumptions.
paper_title: An Agentic Formalization for Certified Quantum Neural Network Design
